messages:
neel: Heads-up — need to route signature for a POC orderform + staging invoice. Customer requires SSO proof, KMS attestation, and a PO. Approval path requested: sales manager -> finance for amounts > $25k. Can we use our DocuSign flow or do legal/procurement need an alternate routing? Need to close by EOD Thurs.

emily (sales-ops): Order form attached (placed in drive: https://drive.internal/r/po-acme-poc). Invoice is for $18,750 initially, with a staged invoice of $6,250 on go-live. POC window 30 days.

raj (finance): If it's $18,750 we can likely do sales-mgr + finance reviewer. Net30? Also need vendor tax ID and billing contact before we accept PO. Can we get an electronic PO?

sarah (legal): Quick Q: did they send any MSA/DPA redlines with this PO? If there are redlines around KMS/HSM or data residency we'll need to review before approving esign path. Generally we accept DocuSign standard envelope + our esign clause, but KMS attestation sometimes needs an addendum. I can do a 48h review if we have redlines.

neel: No redlines received yet — I'll ask the AE to push the MSA/DPA. For KMS they specifically want proof of key management flow and a written attestation. Is that something legal can approve as an addendum or does it need SRE sign-off?

sarah (legal): We can draft a one-paragraph KMS addendum for this customer; will loop in infra if we need technical wording. Ask them for the exact attestation language they expect.

emily (sales-ops): I pinged the buyer for the PO and attestation language. They said they'll send PO by EOD.

raj (finance): If PO comes tonight, finance needs invoice workflow: staged invoices are fine but we need a billing email + ACH wiring instructions or net terms. Also confirm whether we should net the staged invoice into a single orderform or create two invoices.

neel: Preference is single orderform with milestone invoices. Emily — please include billing contact and tax id.

emily (sales-ops): Will do. Also — question on routing: can we put this through the standard DocuSign template but change sign order to: 1) AE (placeholder), 2) Sales Manager, 3) Customer exec, 4) Finance (for PO attach), 5) Legal (review only, post-sign)? Or does legal need to sign?

sarah (legal): Legal doesn't sign most OrderForms. We can be set as a reviewer (post-sign acceptance) unless there are redlines. If they require legal signature, escalate and I'll approve signing only for high-risk clauses.

docu-sign-bot: Template found: "Redwood - OrderForm v3". Suggested routing: signerOrder = ["sales_mgr","customer_exec","finance_billing"]. Link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OFv3. You can override routing in the API: ```{
  "templateId": "OFv3",
  "signerOrder": [1,2,3]
}```

neel: That works. Raj — can finance accept the DocuSign envelope with PO attached, or do you need a separate submission?

raj (finance): Attach PO into envelope or upload to our AP portal; either is ok. If attached to envelope, we need a copy in our accounting system as well. Emily, can you add a line in the envelope to include PO number and billing reference?

emily (sales-ops): Yes. Also tagging @sarah — once legal confirms addendum wording I can include it as an attachment in the envelope so the customer signs both.

sarah (legal): I'll draft the KMS addendum today and circulate a short approval note. If they push redlines that reference HSM attestation or SOC2 equivalence, I'll need 24-48h with infra.

neel: Thanks. Action items: 1) Emily to upload PO and billing contact + attach MSA/DPA (if any) — target: EOD today. 2) Sarah to draft KMS addendum — target: today. 3) Raj to confirm net terms and invoice format — target: tomorrow AM. 4) I will prepare DocuSign envelope with routing per docu-sign-bot and include placeholders.

emily (sales-ops): Updating drive with billing contact and placeholder PO once buyer sends. Will notify thread. :thumbsup:

raj (finance): FYI — if the buyer wants Net45 we need additional SL approval. Keep me posted.

sarah (legal): Draft done and uploaded: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-addendum-acme-v1.docx. Minimal wording: attestation of KMS controls + statement that keys are managed in customer region. Will tweak if infra asks for specifics.

neel: Perfect. Emily — once PO lands, can you go ahead and send envelope and mark "for signature"? I'll stand by for final review.

emily (sales-ops): Yep. If PO arrives tonight I'll prepare the envelope and set sign order.

neel: Great — thanks everyone. Will close this thread once envelope is out. :rocket:
